description: This file contains the main engine control logic for a vehicle engine management system. It includes initialization, periodic updates, trigger handling, sensor management, fault detection, and engine shutdown procedures. The file integrates various modules such as fuel calculation, ignition control, trigger shape initialization, and state management, indicating it is a central component of the firmware.

classes.name: FsioState
classes.description: Represents the state of the filesystem input/output subsystem, with flags for engine warnings and critical conditions, initialized in its constructor.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Main class managing engine control, including initialization, sensor updates, trigger handling, shutdown sequences, and diagnostic routines.

methods.name: initializeTriggerShape
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape, sets up synchronization points, and prepares output signals if the trigger shape is valid.

methods.name: cylinderCleanupControl
methods.description: Controls the cylinder cleanup mode based on RPM and throttle position thresholds.

methods.name: periodicSlowCallback
methods.description: Performs less frequent, heavy-duty tasks such as sensor updates, shutdown checks, and filesystem I/O.

methods.name: updateSlowSensors
methods.description: Updates sensor data like fuel level and battery voltage, and manages engine state updates.

methods.name: onTriggerSignalEvent
methods.description: Handles trigger signal events, updates the trigger event timestamp and sets engine spin state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets engine state variables and cycle counters to default values.

methods.name: preCalculate
methods.description: Performs pre-computation tasks such as spark table calculations and MAF curve decoding based on current configuration.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Applies a new configuration to the engine, initializing related parameters.

methods.name: printKnockState
methods.description: Logs current knock detection state for diagnostics.

methods.name: knockLogic
methods.description: Determines whether knocking is detected based on sensor voltage, updates knock count and timing.

methods.name: watchdog
methods.description: Monitors engine spin status and shuts down if the engine is unresponsive within a certain timeout.

methods.name: checkShutdown
methods.description: Checks battery voltage and RPM to determine if engine shutdown procedures should be initiated.

methods.name: isInShutdownMode
methods.description: Returns whether the engine is in the process of shutting down or has stopped.

methods.name: getCurrentInjectionMode
methods.description: Determines current fuel injection mode based on engine status (cranking or normal).

methods.name: periodicFastCallback
methods.description: Executes fast, time-sensitive tasks such as sensor refreshes and logging.
